No mandatory cloud

Standard artifacts: Postgres stays Postgres, containers stay containers. One command scaffolds what your platform needs.

pyweb deploy --target docker               # build+serve+HEALTHCHECK
pyweb deploy --target compose --db-url $DATABASE_URL
pyweb deploy --target k8s --image registry/shop:v1  # liveness+readiness

docker build -t shop . && docker run -p 8000:8000 shop
# /healthz answers; probes already wired
TargetYou get
Linux VMpyweb serve dist behind any reverse proxy; systemd unit pattern in docs
DockerGenerated Dockerfile: build → non-root serve → HEALTHCHECK /healthz
KubernetesDeployment + Service with liveness/readiness probes wired to /healthz
Static + API splitHashed dist/static on any CDN; Python server anywhere
Zero lock-in rule: every artifact PyWeb emits (SQL, HTML, JS, containers, manifests) is usable without PyWeb. The framework adds intelligence; it never takes your data hostage.
PyWeb — Python from browser to database. Core open source (MIT). Self-host anywhere; no mandatory cloud.GitHubRoadmapBenchmarks
